summary: End-to-end testing of the borrower-side Ada concierge. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (list access-control, SSE chat streaming + persistence, LOX PDF generation with %PDF- validation, personal-guarantee broker_note handoff, admin run-nudges counters, rate-quote & qualification guardrails). Frontend: fixed a compile-blocking JSX syntax error in AdaChatPanel.jsx (unescaped quotes in placeholder), then verified panel/greeting/quickstart-buttons/chat streaming/draft card with View + Approve & Upload — all working. Regression: existing client-scenario-* checklist elements still render.
action_items: Review the placeholder fix (unescaped inner double-quotes) I applied in AdaChatPanel.jsx line 165 — it was blocking the entire frontend build with SyntaxError, so no borrower could load /portal until fixed.

Consider adding a `data-testid="ada-quickstart-*"` (or documenting `ada-suggest-*`) — the review_request referenced quickstart testids but the implementation uses `ada-suggest-{first-20-chars}`. Cosmetic only.

Ada tends to ask clarifying questions before generating a resume unless the borrower explicitly says 'do not ask questions, emit generate_doc now'. LOX generates on first ask when reason is given. Consider tuning ADA_SYSTEM_PROMPT to be slightly more eager for resume when borrower already gave role + units + name.
server.py is now ~5845 lines — continue flagging for future modularization.
critical_code_review_comments: AdaChatPanel.jsx had an inline JSX SyntaxError (nested double-quotes in placeholder) that shipped and broke frontend build — a lint/type-check gate would catch this before commit.

View-draft opens a blob URL via window.open; works in real browsers but not testable via Playwright's expect_page for blob:. Consider offering a fallback anchor download for testability/accessibility.
SSE endpoint writes user + assistant messages transactionally but nothing prevents a stream failure mid-way from leaving the user message orphaned. Consider a rollback or a stream_state flag.

seed_data_creation: Chat messages were created and reset (POST /api/client/ada/reset) after each pass so db.borrower_ada_messages is clean for sample user. One draft PDF (Resume draft) and one broker_note admin task remain from tests (they are ephemeral/non-approved and can be manually removed if desired).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ada uses SSE via fetch()+reader (POST /api/client/ada/chat). Done event carries {text, drafts_created[], uploads_done[], broker_notes[]}. Quickstart buttons use testid pattern `ada-suggest-{first 20 chars}` not `ada-quickstart-*`. To reliably trigger generate_doc during automation, provide full details in one prompt and add 'do not ask questions, emit generate_doc now' — otherwise Ada may interview first. LOX generates readily; resume/business_plan/PFS need more context up-front. `/api/admin/ada/run-nudges` returns {considered,sent,skipped_quiet} — safe to call in tests, uses Postmark but tolerates unverified recipients.
